svg.title: Departures: what I'm building now
svg.desc: Departures board listing current projects: Business OS (retail POS and storefront, in service); LEARN (live study workspace and editable public canvas); AllChess (current standalone app with 21 games, browser bots and local play); UrCut and UrVoice (latest local editor and voice engine, public release pending); CodeAge (browser AI workbench, web alpha); EdSync (official classroom app, account access); Living Kingdom and Sandline (Unreal prototypes with browser editions); OmniDrama (two original 12-second chapters in a public browser preview, separate Windows library). Updated October 2026.
